observations: Photo 0 shows a collection of used car parts leaning against a wall.
Visible items include two drive shafts (axle shafts) with rubber boots, a steering rack (steering gear), a radiator (condenser), and a starter motor.
The parts appear heavily used, dusty, and show signs of wear and rust.
No brand names, logos, or model numbers are legible in the photo.

claims.claim: Scrap car metal parts available for sale
Note: This car parts is being sold as is, for parts, repair or recycling. Buyer is responsible for pickup.
claims.evidence: The seller's note is a standard disclaimer; the photo shows the items but not the seller's location.

risks.risk: The parts may be from a different vehicle model than the one the buyer intends to use.
risks.proof: A photo of the manufacturer's plate or a clear photo of the engine/transmission area showing the vehicle identification number (VIN).
risks.if_unproven: as parts from an unknown vehicle

risks.risk: The starter motor may be seized or unable to turn.
risks.proof: A video showing the starter motor being engaged and cranking over.

risks.risk: The radiator may have internal leaks or be blocked.
risks.proof: A photo of the radiator with the top tank removed to check for leaks.

risks.risk: The steering rack may have internal damage or excessive play.
risks.proof: A video showing the steering gear being operated through a full lock-to-lock cycle.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the manufacturer's plate or engine/transmission area showing the vehicle identification number (VIN).
Video of the starter motor being tested.
Photo of the radiator with the top tank removed.
Video of the steering rack being operated.
response.reason: The items are clearly identifiable as car parts from photo 0. They can be priced at their worst-case value as used, non-functional scrap.
